title: Healing
definition: Healing is God's work of restoring, sustaining, or strengthening people physically, emotionally, spiritually, and ultimately in the resurrection.
summary: God may heal in this life, sustain through weakness, or complete healing in glory. Believers pray with faith while trusting God's wisdom and will.
christFocus: Christ healed many during His earthly ministry, showing compassion and pointing forward to final restoration.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God may heal in this life, sustain through weakness, or complete healing in glory. Believers pray with faith while trusting God's wisdom and will.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
